product.description: Monoprice™Entegrade Series Cat8 RJ45 Tool-less Shielded Keystone Jack for Round 22–24AWG Solid Wire Ethernet Cable, 40Gbps, Gold-Plated RJ45 ContactsCreate clean, high-performance Cat8 network terminations with the Monoprice Entegrade Series Cat8 RJ45 Tool-less Shielded Keystone Jack. Designed for round 22–24AWG solid wire Ethernet cable, this keystone jack features a tool-less termination design that simplifies installation while delivering fast, reliable results in professional networking environments. Built for bandwidth-intensive applications, this shielded Cat8 keystone jack supports data transmission speeds up to 40Gbps and is well-suited for structured cabling installations where performance and signal integrity matter.
